item.text: The training-signal topic’s best gain is small, and recent variants remain near baseline. I’ll merge the history-representation and target-conditioned-readout topics to test their compatibility. Both show larger provisional gains; the comparison must retain both source bests, measure added cost, and test whether the combination beats the stronger source.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

decision = {
    'action': 'merge',
    'reason': 'After 24 attempts, the current topic gains only 0.000272 AUC and recent controls remain near baseline. History representation and target-conditioned readout show provisional gains of 0.005747 and 0.001973. Their compatibility is unresolved; the existing statistics/groups combination also failed to beat its entry source. Retain both frozen bests, compare against the stronger source, and account for capacity and measured training/inference cost.',
    'evidence_refs': [
        'baseline-din',
        'g3-r0001-expected_permuted',
        'g3-r0005-stable_aligned',
        'g3-r0005-stable_expected',
        'g3-r0005-reordered_expected',
        'g3-r0005-stable_blocked',
        'g1-r0006-paired_match',
        'g2-r0001-target_separate',
        'g1-r0005-match_groups',
        'g0-r0006-groups_evidence'
    ],
    'topic': {
        'title': 'Compatibility of grouped history evidence and target-conditioned readout',
        'question': 'Does combining the strongest history representation with target-conditioned readout outperform both frozen source bests, especially paired_match, under the same visible inputs and training protocol, with capacity and measured cost controlled?',
        'hypothesis': 'The separate source gains motivate testing whether target-conditioned readout can use information retained by grouped history representations. They do not establish complementary mechanisms and may reflect redundant target matching. Preserve both frozen source bests as utility controls and use matched-capacity, target-independent readout controls to distinguish conditioning from extra capacity. Failure to exceed paired_match would leave incremental utility unsupported; gains matched by the target-independent control would leave conditioning unsupported. Reserve budget for attribution and repetition, and report training and inference cost alongside AUC and logloss.'
    },
    'source_topic_ids': ['g1-t000', 'g2-t000'],
    'merge_control_refs': ['g1-r0006-paired_match', 'g2-r0001-target_separate']
}
path = Path('/workspace/topic-decision.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(decision, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n')
loaded = json.loads(path.read_text())
assert loaded['action'] == 'merge'
assert len(loaded['source_topic_ids']) == 2
assert len(loaded['merge_control_refs']) == 2
assert set(loaded['merge_control_refs']).issubset(loaded['evidence_refs'])
assert set(loaded['topic']) == {'title', 'question', 'hypothesis'}
print('Wrote and validated /workspace/topic-decision.json')
PY"
